Name: Normal climb -- all engines operating
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of engine thrust, aerodynamic drag and atmosphere in a steady state normal climb condition conforms to the aeroplane.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Clean or specified climb configuration | Alt[ft]: 3000 | IAS[kts]: 80 | Flaps: 0
Tolerance: ± 3 kts airspeed | ± 5% or ± 0.5 m/s (100 ft/min) R/C (Rate of Climb)

Name: One engine inoperative second segment climb
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of engine thrust, aerodynamic drag and atmosphere in an engine out second segment climb condition conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 3 kts airspeed | ± 5% or ± 0.5 m/s (100 ft/min) R/C but not less than applicable AFM values

Name: Engine acceleration
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulated engine acceleration conforms to the validation data.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Approach or Landing | Alt[ft]: 2000 | IAS[kts]: 80 | Flaps: 0 | Throttle[%]: 5
Tolerance: ± 10% Ti or ± 0.25 s | ± 10% Tt (Ti: 10% response, Tt: 90% go-around power)

Name: Engine deceleration
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulated engine deceleration conforms to the aeroplane.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Approach or Landing | Alt[ft]: 2000 | IAS[kts]: 80 | Flaps: 0 | Throttle[%]: 100
Tolerance: ± 10% Tt (Total time from initial throttle movement until 90% flight idle throttle movement)

Name: Pitch control column position vs force
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator pitch controller position vs. pitch controller force conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% force | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% column position | ± 2º elevator (where applicable)

Name: Roll control wheel position vs force
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator roll controller position vs. roll controller force conform to the aeroplane.
Tolerance: ± 1.3 daN (3 lbs) or ± 10% force | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% wheel position | ± 2º aileron/spoiler

Name: Rudder pedal position vs force
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator rudder pedal position vs. rudder pedal force conform to the aeroplane.
Tolerance: ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% force | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% pedal position | ± 2º rudder

Name: Pitch trim system rate and authority
Tolerance: ± 10% travel rate | ± 0.5 s or ± 10% time for full travel | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% cockpit trim control

Name: Rudder trim system rate and authority
Tolerance: ± 10% travel rate | ± 0.5 s or ± 10% time for full travel | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% rudder trim control

Name: Longitudinal trim
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator inter-relationship of lift, drag, thrust and longitudinal trim conform to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 1.5º pitch angle | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) or ± 10% pitch control position | ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) column force

Name: Stick force per g -- normal and accelerated turning
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of manoeuvring stability, normally measured as stick force per “g” conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 1.3 daN (3 lbs) or ± 10% stick force | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) or ± 10% column position | ± 0.1 g normal acceleration

Name: Longitudinal static stability -- cruise and approach
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of static longitudinal stability conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: Positive stick force / airspeed gradient | ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% column force | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) column position

Name: Phugoid dynamics
Objective: To demonstrate, that the FTD phugoid dynamics conform to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 10% period of oscillation | ± 0.02 or ± 20% damping ratio (T1/2 time to half amplitude)

Name: Short period dynamics
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator short period dynamic characteristics conform to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 10% period of oscillation or ± 15% frequency (wn) | ± 0.05 or ± 15% damping ratio (zeta)

Name: Pitch response to pitch controller input (step/pulse)
Tolerance: ± 10% or ± 2º/s pitch rate | ± 1.5º pitch attitude | ± 0.1 g normal acceleration

Name: Pitch control authority -- dynamic response
Tolerance: ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) or ± 10% pitch control | ± 10% pitch rate response | Correct directional recovery

Name: Pitch trim change due to flap deployment
Objective: To demonstrate, that the FSTD response to a flap retraction in the second to the third segment climb condition conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 1.5º pitch angle | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) pitch control position | ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) column force

Name: Pitch trim change due to gear deployment
Objective: To demonstrate, that the FSTD response to a landing gear retraction conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 1.5º pitch angle | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) pitch control position | ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) column force

Name: Pitch trim change due to thrust / power change
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator response to an engine power change conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 1.5º pitch angle | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) pitch control position | ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) column force

Name: Roll response (rate and time constant)
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator roll-rate response to roll control input conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 10% or ± 2º/s roll rate | ± 10% or ± 0.1 s roll time constant (tau) | ± 2º bank angle

Name: Spiral stability
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of the dynamic lateral/directional characteristics in the spiral mode conform to the validation data.
Tolerance: Correct spiral tendency (positive, neutral or correct divergence rate) | ± 10% or ± 1 s time to double/half bank angle

Name: Dutch roll dynamics -- yaw damper ON and OFF
Objective: To demonstrate that the lateral/directional dynamic stability characteristics of the FSTD in the dutch roll mode conform to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 10% Dutch roll period | ± 0.02 or ± 20% damping ratio (zeta / T1/2 time to half amplitude)

Name: Steady sideslip (directional and lateral static stability)
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator exhibits the correct inter-relationship of steady state lateral/directional flight characteristics in conformance with the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 1.5º sideslip angle (beta) | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) or ± 10% rudder position | ± 1.5 cm or ± 10% wheel position | ± 2º bank angle

Name: Rudder response to controller input (step/pulse)
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator directional response from rudder control movements conform to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 10% or ± 1.5º/s yaw rate (r) | ± 1.5º sideslip angle (beta) | ± 1.5 cm or ± 10% pedal displacement

Name: Aileron response to controller input (step/pulse)
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of roll characteristics after a roll control input has been removed conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 10% or ± 2º/s roll rate (p) | ± 2º bank angle (phi) | ± 1.5 cm or ± 10% wheel displacement

Name: Cross-coupling -- roll due to rudder (dihedral effect)
Tolerance: ± 2º bank angle | ± 1.5º/s roll rate resulting from sustained sideslip / rudder input

Name: Cross-coupling -- yaw due to roll controller (adverse yaw)
Tolerance: ± 1.5º sideslip angle | ± 1.0º/s yaw rate during initial aileron input

Name: Visual system latency / transport delay
Objective: To confirm, that the cue correlation and responses of the visual and instruments are sufficient to be representative of the cues perceived in the FSTD.
Tolerance: Visual system response within 100 ms of pilot controller displacement (transport delay <= 100 ms)

Name: Visual field of view (FOV) geometry
Tolerance: Continuous horizontal FOV >= 150º (or 180º for level D) | Vertical FOV >= 30º (± 2º tolerance)

Name: Visual ground / runway alignment and spatial geometry
Objective: To demonstrate that the visual System ground segment visible to the pilot at a given height and RVR is similar to this class of airplane.
Tolerance: Runway visual scene alignment within ± 1º heading and ± 0.5º glidepath alignment at decision height
